rule: A strategy's text, sample window and exit gates are committed before its first graded game. The commit hash is the registration.
threshold: a commit that predates the graded window
measured: the model and the metrics in this desk were committed on 2026-11-15, AFTER the 138 games they are graded on
action: Every number on this desk is labelled IN-SAMPLE (retrospective). None of it can be promoted until a post-registration window exists. The registration record is x3/data/preregistration.csv.

rule: At least 200 graded games per division before a strategy is ranked publicly.
action: Both strategies stay on the paper board. At the current rate (about 14 games a week) the 200-game mark lands around week 23, i.e. after this regular season.

rule: Every graded game is predicted from games that finished before it. The ridge penalty is chosen by an inner walk-forward inside the training window, never on the graded week.
threshold: 0 games predicted using their own result
measured: 0 violations; the fit for week W uses only weeks < W

rule: Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.10 across every hypothesis in this desk, with the count of hypotheses published.
measured: 3 hypotheses carry a p-value (side, total, combo)
action: The BH step and the hypothesis count are on the requirements page. With 3 hypotheses a single discovery is weak evidence and is treated as such.

rule: Promotion reads the signal column only. A strategy may not be ranked, promoted or demoted on ROI, because no price exists.
threshold: 0 leaderboard rows ordered by a return
measured: 0 — the sort key is the signal column and the gate asserts it

rule: A parlay or same-game combo may be ranked only when a directly validated joint probability exists AND the operator's void/push rules are stored.
action: S-03 is published as a gap measurement (observed joint vs the product of marginals), never as a ranked strategy.

rule: Every correlation is computed from numbers that came from an official page, and each value carries its n.
threshold: n published for every row; 0 rows with a made-up n
measured: 5 of 5 rows carry n; 1 of 5 is UNDEFINED and says so

rule: A live strategy returns to paper the moment ANY of: (a) its rolling 40-game hit rate is at or below 0.50, (b) its Brier skill against its own benchmark is negative over 40 graded games, (c) it has been live four weeks with no graded game, (d) its data source fails a schema check.
measured: nothing is live on this desk, so no trigger can fire; the rule is dry-run instead
action: The gate script injects a 40-game window at 0.45 and a negative-Brier history and asserts that D-1 fires on both. See x3/gates.html for the dry-run output.

rule: A paper strategy is archived when its 95% interval for the signal excludes the benchmark on the adverse side in two consecutive windows.
measured: 1 window available (the season to date); no second window exists
action: Nothing is archived on one window. The rule is published so the next window can fire it.
